difficulty.notes: The Swedish official page says blue difficulty and the English page says Blue. Official prose says most of the stage is easy forest road, but the Snapparp-Mårenäs part has slopes, boardwalks and rooted forest path.

routeType.notes: Fifth researched section of Mellersta delleden/Central inland branch in the local M numbering. The current official GPX starts at Långesjön and ends at Rydöbruk. Several secondary/legacy sources still preserve Långesjön-Sandsjön or Sandsjön context, but that is not the current official M5 endpoint.
routeType.descriptionForAppDraft: From Långesjön the trail heads through forest and old rural landscapes toward Bockasten and old road-maintenance stones before continuing past the Gislavedsleden connection near Kollabo. The route follows Kilan toward Karl XI:s källa/Kungakällan, crosses highway 26 with care, then approaches Rydöbruk through the Skärkeån canyon and the historic mill/industrial community by Nissan. The section is mostly easy forest road, with a rougher Snapparp-Mårenäs stretch of slopes, roots and boardwalks. There is shelter and toilet access at Långesjön, strong bus access at Rydöbruk, but no official potable drinking water on the section.
